model: Carbon fibre tube 20 mm OD × 18 mm ID, roll-wrapped, woven finish, 1 m
notes: The tail arm (cut to length; the mass in a design is per metre × length). Bending at an 80 N tip load on a 0.36 m arm: about 107 MPa, a factor of 6 on the published strength.

model: Fail-safe tail lock: spring-applied steel pawl on a 60 mm ratchet ring, 24 V pull solenoid to release
price_note: ASSUMED: a 24 V pull solenoid (~$15), a laser-cut steel ratchet ring and pawl (SendCutSend, ~$20)
notes: Assumed part. Powered, the solenoid holds the pawl clear and the tail moves freely. Unpowered (e-stop, flat battery, a pulled pack) the spring drops the pawl into the ratchet: the tail can still swing down but cannot be pushed up, so it props the robot. The RS-06 has no brake of its own.
